name: merge-task-row-unset-columns
body: node_merge's Task arm emits only title and status for a Task row, so a merged-but-unscanned Task row leaves kind/tier/verb/target/new_fqn unset against the still-wide schema until task-6 lands the narrow Task table. Upgrade: when task-6 narrows the rel table or task-20 removes the residual record fields, re-check any code that reads those columns from a merge-written row.
